additional_info.subject: RE: ID404272-DC/Si-D/PL-[Y2/S3 300000004049] CMS issue CRM:01811000649
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I am attaching the information from the installer to start with:
“After installing the Siemens SICHARGE charging station serial no. Y2/S3 300000004049 we proceeded to unlock the CMS consecutively on both CCS 2 cables. The left system was unlocked without any problems. While unlocking the right system, we noticed that the cable responsible for holding the cable up was visibly abraded where the cable mechanism lock (a screw with a washer on the cable) was attached. The damage is documented in the photo below. Before the cable could be re-secured so that it would not be retracted by the retractor, the cable snapped and was pulled by CMS. After reporting the situation to a SIEMENS representative, it became clear that the entire system needed to be replaced.
Due to the factory-damaged cord, I am requesting a warranty repair.”
Unfortunately, I don't have more pictures besides the already mentioned retractor. According to the post, the case looks like factory damage and the cable has rubbed around the steel washer.
Installers are the people who are responsible for connecting and installing the charger at a given location. They are responsible for the installation protocols.
Yesterday we were on site, the retractor was coiled with the rest of the cable, we replaced it with a new one. We will conduct the NCC process.
The station has the CMS installed according to the instructions included in the package, hence the positioning of the clamps in this way.
We will most likely change this setting when a failure occurs in the future, for the moment we leave it as it is in the video and photos. I will attach the repair protocol in the near future.
Z wyrazami szacunku
Zespół Smart Infrastructure
Best regards
Smart Infrastructures Team
